rubrics.justification: Uses the provided 3AA label appropriately, but the image itself does not clearly support a confidently compact A-grade ICM or uniformly cohesive A-grade TE; several detailed claims (clear ICM boundary, continuous TE, no collapse) are somewhat overcalled from this image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, BMI, endometrium, prior cycle history, semen parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, especially around age-related aneuploidy tempering strong morphology; minor overprecision in probability adjustments and some speculative morphology details prevent a perfect score.

Generally consistent with IVF practice and supports single embryo transfer appropriately; however, some recommendations (routine PGT-A encouragement, DHEA/CoQ10/ERA suggestions) are more controversial or conditional than presented.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, counseling, and future-cycle planning, with specific and clinically usable recommendations.
